headline: Founder Who Sold JPMorgan Four Million Imaginary College Students Is Sentenced to Seven Years
deck: Charlie Javice got 85 months in prison after a jury convicted her and Olivier Amar of selling JPMorgan a $175M startup built on an $18,000 fake spreadsheet.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: 85 months federal prison for fabricating 4 million student accounts in a $175M sale to JPMorgan Chase (~$41.18 per synthetic row).
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Forging pay stubs to obtain a $1,800 personal loan
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: 18–24 months prison, typically detected before a single dollar is wired

sources.title: Frank Founder Charlie Javice Sentenced to 85 Months in Prison for Defrauding JPMorgan Chase in $175 Million Acquisition
